data.name: Daryanaat
data.gender_notes: Daryanaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Dariyah’ which means 'a place of gardens, a place of flowers'. The name Daryanaat is often given to a girl born in a family blessed with abundance and prosperity. The name Daryanaat carries the meaning “Gentle Flowers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daryanaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blossoming of inner peace and self-love, representing the beauty and grace of nature.
data.etymology: Daryanaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Flowers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daryanaat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
